Why Leagues and Brands Order Direct

Bowling shirts have two very different buyers: leagues that need twenty shirts with twenty different names on them, and brands selling the camp-collar silhouette as fashion. Both are badly served by the usual print-shop route, where individual names carry a surcharge and the base garment is whatever blank was in stock.

Manufacturing the shirt from scratch removes both problems. The pattern is ours, so the fit is specified rather than inherited; names are part of the production run rather than an add-on; and a brand run can carry your own woven labels and packaging. Twenty pieces covers a league team, fifty starts a retail line. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

Can every shirt have a different name on it?

Yes - individual names are standard on league orders and carry no per-shirt setup penalty. Send a name and size list with your artwork and each shirt is produced to that list.

What is the minimum order for custom bowling shirts?

20 pieces per design for league and team orders. Private-label retail runs with your own labels and packaging start at 50 pieces.

How much does a custom bowling shirt cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Comparable published baselines on our pricing page run $13-19 depending on whether the shirt is a woven camp-collar or a sublimated performance jersey, with name personalisation itemised separately.

Do you make the retro camp-collar style?

Yes - the open camp collar, straight hem and contrast side panels of the classic bowling shirt, in poly-cotton or performance poly, with chain-stitch or embroidered lettering.

How long does a bowling shirt order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days.
